scope: PIT operator mechanisms; specific implementation examples pinned to1.30.2. Current official docs separate from pinned implementation.

claims: Named mutation rules and selectable operator families.
INCREMENTS targets local variables, field increments compiled differently.
VOID_METHOD_CALLS removes eligible void calls, not numerical return substitution.
REMOVE_CONDITIONALS offers forced outcomes for different kinds of comparison.
